component.name: YouTube Comment Extractor
component.summary: Extract and analyze YouTube video comments with GTK4 and Libadwaita

description.p: A native GTK4/Libadwaita application for Linux that allows users to extract, filter, export, and analyze comments from YouTube videos. Features advanced sampling strategies (uniform random, bounded pool, sequential) and multi-format exports (CSV with emojis, formatted JSON, YouTube-styled HTML).
Updated app icons conforming with GNOME Human Interface Guidelines, multi-resolution icon theme packages, and multi-format export parity.
